title: Noha tha sakina ka
body:
zindan may sakina ki hai sada aajao mere baba
noha tha sakina ka aajao mere baba
<<DIVIDER>>
mushkil hai mera jeena aajao mere baba
noha tha sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon behta hai kano se ruqsaar bhi hai neele
jalta hai mera kurta aajao mere baba
noha tha sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
har gham may musibat hai durro ki aziyat hai
ye haal hai ab mera aajao mere baba
noha tha sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
loota gaya zewar bhi cheeni gayi chadar bhi
dhaate hai sitam aada aajao mere baba
noha tha sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo ran ko gaya baba wapas wo nahi aaya
qaime may hai sannata aajao mere baba
noha tha sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene pa sina khaaye akbar bhi gaye maare
pamaal hua dulha aajao mere baba
noha tha sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jalte hai sabhi qaime faryad kare kis se
ab kaun bachayega aajao mere baba
noha tha sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
neendh aayegi ab kyunkar soyegi kahan dukhtar
yaad aayega wo seena aajao mere baba
noha tha sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
chadar bhi nahi sar par le jaate hai wo dar dar
hai qaid may wo kunba aajao mere baba
noha tha sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehdije hilal us ja ek shor tha girya tha
jab kehti thi wo dukhya aajao mere baba
noha tha sakina ka...
author: Hilal Mirza
